label: The partnership
text: Own the technical strategy for TrendAI's AWS partnership end to end — positioning, roadmap alignment with AWS product and business teams, and the executive narrative on both sides of it.

label: Teams
text: Led 17 people — 14 developers and 3 subject matter experts — through post-launch support of a statewide platform. Ran the standups, the 1:1s, the code reviews, and the hiring: campus recruiting through final-round interviews.

label: Enablement
text: Built a year-long certification program for 20 client developers, and the training modules and materials a sales organization ran on. Practice-building, not one-off delivery.

label: The ecosystem
text: Host AWS Partnerships re:Imagined. Technical resource at AWS Summits and Black Hat, representing TrendAI to partners and the wider security community.
